title: Sort each reaction into the correct type
instructions: Drag each chemical reaction on the left into the correct type bin. Look for the form: A + B → AB is combination; AB → A + B is decomposition; A + BC → AC + B is displacement; AB + CD → AD + CB is double displacement.

bins.name: Combination
bins.description: Two or more reactants combine into one product.

bins.name: Decomposition
bins.description: One reactant breaks down into two or more products.

bins.name: Displacement
bins.description: More reactive element displaces a less reactive element from its compound.

bins.name: Double displacement
bins.description: Two compounds exchange ions; AB + CD → AD + CB.
